S1.question: Chunk memory and band switches at zoom 0.3-2.0
S1.method: ?debug=1&scene=spike-map&auto=1&secs=300 (js/engine/render/scenes.js): the real renderer (js/engine/render/terrain.js bands near 8x8 tiles TSCALE 2 / mid 16x16 TSCALE 1 / far 16x16 TSCALE 0.5, LRU 36/27/48, width=height=0 eviction, +-0.03 hysteresis, 1 bake per frame, tile-colour placeholder) on B's 128 stub map (massif, tunnels, halls, river, walled rooms, sconces); scripted serpentine pans of the whole map in each band with zoom ramps through the band edges (near 1.25, mid 0.6, far 0.33) for 5 minutes; blank check = canvas pixels equal to the void colour inside the map rect, sampled every 30 frames
S1.note: Playwright WebKit cannot be installed here (the browser download host is blocked by the network policy), so this ran in Chromium (V8/Blink) at the gate viewports with DPR 2. Bake and frame ms are desktop numbers.

decision.rule: keep the 12.4 sizes (held never above near 36 + mid 27 = 63 MB; 0 blank pixels; 0 failed bakes). If the iPhone 13 canvas-memory ceiling is under 160 MB: near LRU 30 and sprite cache 40 MB (12.5)

confirmOnDevice: iOS canvas-memory ceiling over the 5-minute pan (a failed bake = getContext null or a 0-size canvas is counted in failedBakes)
no tab reload during band switches
bake ms on the A15 (desktop p95: near 1.1-1.2, mid 2.0-2.1, far 0.6-0.7 ms; budget: one bake per frame inside 8 ms render)
frame ms on the A15 (desktop p95 3.5-4.2 ms)

S2.question: The look of darkness and light in tunnels
S2.method: ?debug=1&scene=tunnels&check=1&ppt=2|4&smooth=1|0 (js/engine/render/scenes.js, js/engine/render/light.js): a carved map with a 1-tile lit tunnel and a 1-tile dark tunnel under a 1-tile rock wall, a room and a winding tunnel, 5 sconces; light = rt.light (a stand-in BFS blocked by rock until B registers the light rebuild); the light texture gives each wall pixel the level of the open neighbour on its own side; measured at zoom 0.75 (24 pt tiles) over the 15 on-screen tiles of the wall

decision.rule: default 2 px per tile with smoothing (bilinear over half a tile): no leak through a 1-tile wall in any variant (dark tunnel identical under and away from the sconces), the wall is lit on its tunnel face only; 4 px looks the same at 0.75 for 4x the texture cost

confirmOnDevice: owner picks the look on the phone at zoom 0.75 (screenshots above)
1-tile tunnels readable at zoom 0.75 in sunlight and indoors
unlit (level 0) tunnels are near-black on purpose: confirm on device or raise DARK_ALPHA[0]

S3.question: Save time and size
S3.method: synthetic day-200 state (30 colonists, 4,000 stacks, 1,500 buildings, mined map, live raid with 3 flow fields): snapshot + CompressionStream deflate-raw + IndexedDB put

decision.quickSave: RLE + base64 into ec2.quick on pagehide
decision.rule: targets: main thread < 8 ms, blob < 100 KB, put < 50 ms. If missed on the device: positional item rows (fields.js) and per-layer deltas before Stage 1b

confirmOnDevice: snapshot main-thread ms on the A15 (desktop numbers are 2-4x faster)
IndexedDB put ms in Safari and in the Home Screen app
